外部结果无法确认。不要使用新请求编号重复取消；请使用下方按钮保持同一请求身份对账: The external result cannot be confirmed. Do not repeat cancellation with a new request ID. Use the button below to reconcile with the same request identity.
Odoo 已明确拒绝，本地 PO 未被标记为已取消。: Odoo explicitly rejected the request. The local PO has not been marked canceled.
复制订单内容并生成一张独立、未发送的 Readywork 采购订单草稿。: Copy the order contents into a separate, unsent SupplySentry purchase order draft.
新编号必须在当前租户内唯一。: The new number must be unique within this tenant.
说明为什么需要一张新 PO，该内容会进入审计时间线。: Explain why a new PO is needed. This will appear in the audit timeline.
供应商、币种、物料、数量、单价和税务字段；所有行将使用新 ID 和新 RIHD。: Supplier, currency, materials, quantities, unit prices, and tax fields. All lines receive new IDs and the new RIHD.
Odoo 映射、RFQ / Award / 采购需求关系、附件、供应商确认、生产: Odoo mapping; RFQ, award, or requisition links; attachments; supplier confirmations; production; shipments; receipts; exceptions; or communication history.
只有 SQLite 事务提交后才会显示成功；不发邮件、不写 Odoo、不推进源: Success is shown only after the SQLite transaction commits. No emails are sent, Odoo is not updated, and the source PO is not advanced.
从真实供应商回复登记结构化确认: Register structured confirmation from a supplier reply
选择一封已关联当前 PO 的回复: Select a reply linked to the current PO
该通信没有可用的文本正文。: No text body is available for this communication.
后端会重新校验该通信的租户、PO、供应商、方向和接收状态；前端选择本身不能冒充证: The backend revalidates the communication's tenant, PO, supplier, direction, and receipt status. A frontend selection alone is not evidence.
供应商回复结构化解析建议: Suggested structured extraction from supplier reply
确定性规则只生成待核对建议，不会保存、提交、回写 Odoo 或推进 PO 阶段。: Deterministic rules generate suggestions for review only. They do not save, submit, write back to Odoo, or advance the PO stage.
将可靠建议填入空白项: Fill empty fields with reliable suggestions
回复没有将字段明确绑定到某一条 PO 行，未生成可填入的行级值。: The reply does not clearly associate fields with a specific PO line, so no line-level values are available to fill.
所有字段都已提取，但仍需与原邮件逐项核对: All fields extracted; verify each against the original email
按 PO 原值填入未变更项: Fill unchanged fields from original PO
仅填充当前空白项，不会覆盖已录入的差异，也不会保存或提交。交期按租户时区: Fills empty fields only. Existing discrepancies are not overwritten, and nothing is saved or submitted. Delivery dates use the tenant time zone
仅基于当前输入与 PO 原值实时计算，不保存、不提交，也不产生新的业务事实。: Calculated live from current input and original PO values. Nothing is saved or submitted, and no business records are created.
填写全部行后才会给出提交结果预判；空值不会被解释为 0 或沿用 PO。: A submission preview is available only after all lines are completed. Empty values are not treated as 0 or copied from the PO.
提交后将保存供应商确认事实并创建人工审批；批准前不会更新承诺累计，也不会进入生产: Submission saves the supplier confirmation and creates a manual approval request. Committed totals and production stage remain unchanged until approval.
当前输入未发现差异；后端重新校验全部证据与版本后，才可能直接确认并进入生产阶段。: No discrepancies found in the current input. Direct confirmation and advancement to production are possible only after the backend revalidates all evidence and versions.
当前差异未命中人工审批规则；后端重新校验全部证据与版本后，才可能直接确认并进入生: The current discrepancies do not match a manual approval rule. Direct confirmation and advancement to production are possible only after the backend revalidates all evidence and versions.
PO 对比基准不完整，前端无法可靠预判审批结果；提交后仍以后端权威校验为准。: The PO comparison baseline is incomplete, so the frontend cannot reliably predict approval. The backend's authoritative validation determines the result after submission.
数量、单价和交期均需由人明确核对。数量或单价变化、以及交期延后超过: Quantity, unit price, and delivery date must each be explicitly reviewed. Quantity or unit price changes, and delivery delays exceeding
天会创建待审批记录；最终结果仍由后端按最新 PO 版本重新计算。: days create an approval request. The backend recalculates the final result against the latest PO version.
供应商进度邮件、报告或会议纪要编号: Supplier progress email, report, or meeting minutes ID
记录延期原因、缺料、质检问题或供应商说明: Record delay reasons, material shortages, quality issues, or supplier explanations
邮件 Message-ID、附件 ID 或会议纪要地址: Email Message-ID, attachment ID, or meeting minutes URL
说明核对了哪些原始事实，以及为什么可信: Describe the original records reviewed and why they are reliable
这里只保存经人工核验的供应商履约事实，不会自动发信、修改 Odoo 或生成 Sh: This saves manually verified supplier fulfillment records only. It does not send email, update Odoo, or create a Shipment. Fulfilment completes only when all effective PO lines are ready to ship.
输入供应商真实发运单号: Enter the supplier's actual shipment number
输入仓库或 ERP 真实 GRN 号: Enter the warehouse or ERP GRN number
例如 DHL、顺丰: For example, DHL or SF Express
按当前浏览器时区录入，保存时转换为可审计的 ISO 时间。: Enter in the current browser time zone. The value is converted to an auditable ISO timestamp when saved.
例如：邮件 Message-ID、附件编号、Odoo Receipt URL 或: For example: email Message-ID, attachment ID, Odoo Receipt URL, or warehouse proof-of-receipt number
说明你核对了哪些原始事实，以及为什么可以推进 PO 阶段: Describe the original records reviewed and why they support advancing the PO stage
此入口只保存“人工核验事实”，不会冒充供应商、仓库或 ERP 连接器回执；页面也: This saves manually verified records only, identified separately from supplier, warehouse, or ERP connector acknowledgments. It does not send email or update Odoo. Final import GRN remains subject to document security checks.
承运商页面、邮件 Message-ID、提单或报关单编号: Carrier page, email Message-ID, bill of lading, or customs declaration number
说明核对了什么事实以及为什么可信: Describe the records reviewed and why they are reliable
清关节点只对有明确进口路线证据的 PO 开放。承运商“已送达”只是物流节点，最终: Customs milestones are available only for POs with explicit import-route evidence. Carrier delivery is a logistics milestone; final completion still requires warehouse / ERP GRN evidence.
这不是部分发货：批准后剩余量将永久关闭: Approval permanently closes the remaining quantity
如仍需供应商后续交付，请取消审批，继续沟通或选择“要求分批交付”。: If later supplier delivery is needed, cancel this approval and continue communicating or select Request split delivery.
确认后将按顺序执行: After confirmation, the following will run in order
说明为什么接受短交并关闭剩余量: Explain why you accept the short delivery and close the remaining quantity
记录为什么批准或拒绝: Record why you approve or reject
运行时审批不声明幂等；如状态冲突，请先刷新。结果不明时也请先刷新，再决定是否重试: Runtime approval does not guarantee idempotency. Refresh first if the status conflicts or the result is uncertain, then decide whether to retry.
同一请求编号可安全重试，系统会避免重复发送、重复发运、重复收货或重复回写。: The same request ID can be safely retried. The system prevents duplicate sending, shipments, receipts, and ERP writes.
